name: secure-privacy-by-design
description:
Perform a Security and Privacy by Design analysis on a greenfield project or feature.

Use this skill when the user: describes a new project or feature; shares requirements/user stories and wants security or privacy input; asks for a threat model, abuse cases, or security review; mentions "secure by design", "privacy by design", "GDPR", "STRIDE", "LINDDUN", "SRTM", "CRA", or "NIS2"; asks "what could go wrong" from a security perspective; or needs security documentation before development begins.
